question: Can key retrieval or token confusion defeat the ingress profile?
paper_scope: Uses the saved selected-body paper review; not a new proof audit.
decision: Implemented 64 KiB/64-key remote JWKS limits while retaining jose refresh coalescing and cooldown. Added unsigned, wrong algorithm, invalid signature, redirect and oversized document tests. Retained rejection of unsupported proof-bound tokens.
next_question: How should issuer-specific emergency signing-key removal and JWKS cache refresh coordinate with in-flight requests across replicas?

question: Do delegated credentials preserve recipient/scope constraints under concurrent expiry?
paper_scope: Uses the saved selected-body paper review; not a new proof audit.
decision: Fixed duplicate refresh exchanges; tightened JSON, bearer syntax, length, returned scope and issued token type checks. Added explicit keyless OAuth subjects and UI support; retained separate interactive identity-provider responsibilities.
next_question: Which upstream client authentication methods and consent contracts need additional provider adapters?

question: Should relationship facts, roles and caller-supplied arguments expand one another’s authority?
paper_scope: Uses the saved selected-body paper review; not a new proof audit.
decision: Retained strict policy intersection and external model ownership. Added an allow/role/relationship truth-table test and argument/prototype rejection checks. Deferred backend-record authorization until trusted resource binding exists.
next_question: How can conditional relationship attributes be sourced authoritatively and remain fresh across replicas?

question: How can an operator remove a target from alias selection without introducing unsafe failover?
paper_scope: Uses the saved selected-body paper review; not a new proof audit.
decision: Implemented per-target availability in configuration, built-in routing and UI; continued requests recheck selectors and availability. No automatic replay or least-load claims.
next_question: How should health signals, slow-start and explicit direct-access shutdown interact with trusted Router plugins?

question: Can response loss or overload justify retrying a potentially completed action?
paper_scope: Uses the saved selected-body paper review; not a new proof audit.
decision: Retained no automatic tool-effect retries, bounded fan-out, cancellation, rate limits and circuit behavior. Hardened security-service reads and exchange coalescing; deferred retry and outcome reconciliation until backend idempotency is explicit.
next_question: Which discovery requests can be retried under a shared budget, and which ingress/streaming soak tests expose remaining failure modes?

question: Can an operator stop a compromised but unexpired locally verified JWT across every gateway replica?
paper_scope: Normative JWT claim review; not counted as a research paper or article cycle.
decision: Added opt-in shared JWT revocation keyed by issuer and signed jti, with an authenticated admin endpoint, SQLite local support, PostgreSQL shared support, expiry cleanup, fail-closed checks and an atomic revocation-plus-audit transaction. Revocation records contain only a hash; issuer-level key rollover remains a separate control.
validation: test/jwt-revocation.test.js; PostgreSQL cross-pool integration pending a Docker-enabled run.
next_question: Can a whole-issuer emergency stop contain a compromised provider when per-token revocation is insufficient?

question: Can an emergency signing-key incident be contained without relying on an optional or mutable kid value?
paper_scope: Normative JOSE/JWT best-practice review; not counted as a research paper or article cycle.
decision: Added an issuer-wide stop to the shared JWT revocation path so all signed tokens from that configured issuer are blocked regardless of key rotation or token jti. Re-enable is explicit and audited. This avoids trusting mutable or missing kid values while key-thumbprint revocation and JWKS cache invalidation remain open.
validation: test/jwt-revocation.test.js; two-pool PostgreSQL coverage added to integration/services.test.js but not run without Docker.
next_question: How should targeted key-thumbprint revocation and JWKS refresh avoid ambiguity, stale acceptance and refresh stampedes without requiring an issuer-wide outage?

question: Does the gateway send upstream OAuth client secrets using the recommended client authentication method while preserving explicit provider compatibility?
paper_scope: Normative OAuth standards review; not counted as an article or research-paper cycle.
decision: Upstream client credentials now use client_secret_basic by default, with RFC-required form encoding before Basic construction. Request-body client_secret is sent only when client_secret_post is explicitly configured for provider compatibility.
next_question: Can workload identity and asymmetric client authentication be added through a bounded extension without exposing static secrets or weakening destination pins?
